## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or roadmap milestone.

## Validation

List checks or experiments actually run and their results. State clearly when checks were not run.

## Review notes

Describe any configuration, migration, access-policy, or compatibility changes. Include screenshots for interface changes when useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation reflects the implementation status.
- [ ] No credentials, private authentication logs, or generated model artifacts are included.
- [ ] Relevant behavior and authorization checks are covered, where applicable.
- [ ] ML changes describe data splits, leakage prevention, and measured results, where applicable.
